Sports · India

India's Commonwealth Games 2026 Performance and Felicitation

India's contingent at the Commonwealth Games 2026 was felicitated by Sports Minister Mandaviya, who lauded their performance. Mirabai received ₹30 lakh, silver medallists ₹20 lakh, and bronze medallists ₹10 lakh. One weightlifter claimed food poisoning cost her a gold medal. India secured 39 medals in total and will host the 2030 Games in Ahmedabad.
